pending.title: Waiting for payment
pending.description: Open your banking app, pick <0>Pix with QR Code</0> and point the camera at the code.

paid.title: Payment confirmed
paid.description: The bank confirmed the transfer. This charge is settled.

expired.title: Charge expired
expired.description: This QR Code is past its deadline. Issue a new charge to continue.

copyPaste.label: Pix copy and paste
copyPaste.hint: Rather paste it? Use the code below in your banking app.

listening.fallback: The bank pushes the update · double-check every {{seconds}}s

simulation.title: Test bench
simulation.description: Fires POST /webhooks/pix pretending to be the bank. The confirmation does not come back in that response: it arrives over the real-time channel.

missingPayload.title: QR Code unavailable in this session
missingPayload.description: The backend does not return the payload from GET /payments/pix/<id> yet. Issue a new charge to see the QR Code.

errors.loadFailed: We could not load this charge.
errors.copyFailed: We could not copy the code. Please copy it manually.
errors.webhookFailed: The webhook did not accept the notification. Try again.
errors.webhookExpired: This charge has expired. The bank can no longer confirm it — issue a new one.

success.webhookSent: Webhook notified. Waiting for the channel.

qrCaption: Point your banking app camera here
